caption: The drawing is composed of three distinct views of a wooden chair rendered in fine black lines on a beige background. On the left, the chair is shown from the front, revealing four carved vertical spindles forming the backrest, flanked by two larger posts topped with finials. The seat appears to be a woven material, and several turned horizontal supports connect the legs. In the center, a top-down perspective displays the seat, showing a detailed woven pattern and hints at rounded edges with small decorative circular details at two corners towards the rear. On the right, a side view focuses on the chair’s profile, displaying the two main vertical posts, the seat, and three horizontal supports connecting the legs. The drawing is annotated in the lower right corner with scale and measurements. The composition is precise and structured, with the three chair views evenly spaced and dominating the plain background.
title: Chair
